_what: Issue #14 (Phase 389A), the Red Team round 3 of 2026-10-27 10:07, run 20261027_100734_red_team_389A: its one call's structured output, verbatim from the run's stage.json. It stopped at 10:09 on C7 (F228). Kept by Phase 392 as the known-bad case.

findings.what_is_wrong: The record now names `bc50c4b`, the merge of `master`. In that tree, `tests/test_phase255B_collected_test_floor.py:405` reads `COLLECTED_TEST_FLOOR = 11605`. v1.1's Results ("11500 + 105 = 11605, `COLLECTED_TEST_FLOOR` as `master` has it") and the phase log (p. 354) agree with that file. The handoff's figure was true only at `e69c6f6`, and round 3 did not update it.

findings.claim: v1.1 section 5, As built: "the branch's last commit is the close-out commit". The phase log's close-out entry says the same: "It is the branch's last commit, so this log cannot name its hash".
findings.what_is_wrong: The close-out commit is no longer the branch's last commit. After it came the fix-round-2 commit, the operator's merge `bc50c4b` and the round-3 commit `ffcb687`, which is HEAD. Section 3's finish line asks that every commit after the plan commit except the last has an entry naming its hash. The log never names the close-out commit's hash, and never says which hash is the round-2 commit. `e15b462` appears only as the tree issue #14's check failed on. The handoff passes the close-out hash on to "whoever merges" (p. 94–95), even though it can now be named.

findings.claim: v1.1 Deviations list what the branch changed beyond the plan. The close-out names `implementation.md`'s history row and version.
findings.what_is_wrong: The branch's diff from master shows `implementation.md | 3 +-`, which includes a deletion. On the branch, line 3 (the version and date header) reads "0.13.119 | **Date:** 2026-10-25 (Phase 389A …)". The history table also carries 390 and 391, which closed on 2026-10-26 (p. 532–533). So the merge of master appears to replace master's newer header, the one after 391, with 389A's older one, and it may reuse a version number already taken. Neither the plan nor Deviations mentions this, and round 3 says "Nothing was built in that round". Inferred from the diff stat and the dates: no git was run to show master's line 3.

findings.claim: v1.1 Results, Checks bullet: "`wholetree.sh --full` 4530 passed, 36 skipped, exit 0."
findings.what_is_wrong: This is the 2026-10-25 run at `e69c6f6`. The paragraph above it says the 4716 run at `bc50c4b` supersedes the close-out's run, but the bullet gives no date or commit, so it reads as the current figure.
